subject: Rstan: Can 'optimizing' output matricies and vector parameters

messages.author: 59ce4b83b96c74fd
messages.subject: Rstan: Can 'optimizing' output matricies and vector parameters
parts:
Hi,
As it stands when I use 'optimizing' I get all my parameters/estimates returned in a single vector like format.
Is there a way too get a sensible output structure such as a list where each parameter is an entry.
This would allow for vector and matrix parameters to be easily retrieved.
As it stand the output is a mess and difficult to deal with!

It would be great if there was some return statement that added variables to a list to be returned to R.
This would allow the exclusion of certain parameters included in the transformed parameters block,
that are only in there so quantities can be derived from them in the generated quantities block.


Thanks
Chris

messages.subject: Re: Rstan: Can 'optimizing' output matricies and vector parameters

On Friday, 8 July 2016 13:59:15 UTC+12, Ben Goodrich wrote:
On Thursday, July 7, 2016 at 8:43:23 PM UTC-4, Chris Nottingham wrote:
Is there a way too get a sensible output structure such as a list where each parameter is an entry.

Call optimizing() with as_vector = FALSE.

Ben
Thanks, that was too easy. Problems solved.
